exposure: Twin pregnancies were divided into two groups: vertex/vertex and vertex/non-vertex
cohort: 685 women with twin pregnancies where the presenting twin was in the vertex position
finding: Vaginal delivery of a breech second twin when the presenting twin is vertex was found to be as safe as vaginal delivery of twins in the vertex/vertex presentation.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery of a breech second twin after a vertex first twin was found to be as safe as vaginal delivery of twins both in the vertex presentation.
